'''Wielu''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with two [[Star/Legends|suns]], and was well known for its famous beaches and thriving [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] briefly vacationed here.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />
